svg.title: Supply shifts right from S0 to S1; price falls and quantity rises
svg.desc: D through (90, N$10), (60, N$20), (30, N$30); S0 through (30, N$10), (60, N$20), (90, N$30); S1 through (60, N$10), (90, N$20), (120, N$30), to the right of S0 by 30 at every price. E0 at N$20 and 60 packets; E1 at N$15 and 75 packets, both projected to the axes.
svg.text: S0 to S1: 30 more packets supplied at every price
Price falls N$20 to N$15; quantity rises 60 to 75
Supply shifts right; demand does not move.
